text:
riley: Quick kickoff  we need a field-ready one-pager + landing tile for the deploy-mode launch (hosted / dedicated / private). Focus: security, SLA clarity, and predictable unit economics. Target: SDRs, AEs, and a 30-min webinar signup.

tara: Love it. Keep it one page. Sections: 2-line lead, decision matrix (pick this when...), two benchmark tiles, security bullets, tiny engineer checklist, CTA. Also prepare two micro-variants for the landing A/B test: general vs compliance-focus.

ben: Pulling perf numbers now. Proposed copy numbers (for marketing callouts only): p50 gen latency ~88ms (Dedicated, 1k ctx), p95 tail ~310ms (Hosted burst), embedding lat ~16ms. Cost callouts: hosted baseline ~$0.19 /1k tokens, tuned (dedicated + quant + batching) ~$0.033 /1k tokens. Add footnote: "workload dependent".

zara: Webinar hooks: A: "Stop inference surprises: pick the right deploy mode" B: "Predictable SLAs & lower unit cost — real customer results". Landing needs headline + 3 short bullets and a signup CTA.

riley: For inbound routing we must be deterministic so security/compliance leads land with field immediately. Draft HubSpot rules below

```
- tag=security_signal if body contains: FedRAMP OR SOC2 OR "HIPAA" OR "PCI"
- tag=private_interest if body contains: on-prem OR air-gapped OR VPC OR "no-cloud"
- set=enterprise_hot if ARR_est >= 100000 OR company_size >= 2000
- route_to=AE_queue if tag=security_signal OR tag=private_interest OR enterprise_hot==true
- fallback=SDR_queue
- webhook: POST lead + transcript to /eng-solutions for security hits
```

routing-bot: rules staged (rs-2028-06-11-04). Smoke-tests: 9/9 passed.

ben: UX suggestion for the one-pager: two microtiles side-by-side. Left tile = latency (p50/p95), right tile = cost per 1k with tiny footnote. Add a single-line ops quote: "Switched to Redwood Dedicated — consistent tails, predictable bills"  -LatticeCare (pilot).

tara: Engineer quickbox (3 bullets): sample prompt used (chat 64 tokens), expected latency ranges (Dedicated p50 50-110ms, Hosted p95 up to ~330ms), tuning knobs (batch size, KV cache, quant level). Also include a 1-line rollback note: automatic model-variant fallback + canary.

riley: Messaging iteration plan: write two landing variants (general / compliance), run 50/50 traffic for 1 week, measure CTA conversion and downstream AE-qualified rate. If compliance variant wins CTR but lower SQL rate, prioritize AE routing tweaks.

ben: Add micro-FAQ bullets: "What SLA comes with each mode?" (hosted: shared; dedicated: contract SLA; private: custom + network isolation) and "Can we pilot?" (yes  offer 30-day dedicated pilot + migration support).

zara: I'll design the PDF and the single-line HTML snippet for the landing tile. Copy will be scannable with icons and two benchmark tiles. ETA: draft in thread by Thursday AM.

riley: Routing-tested, bench numbers in copy, and two landing variants  sounds good. Once draft is posted, tag eng-sales, solutions, and legal for quick sign-off. Meeting to review: Friday 10:00am PT. :calendar:
